name: Conjure Fey

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: a creature within 5 feet of the spirit

sustain.label: Fey spirit: strike
sustain.help: A Bonus Action: the spirit teleports up to 30 ft and makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 ft of it.

summary: A Medium fey spirit strikes a creature next to it: 3d12 + your modifier Psychic and Frightened.
text: When it appears and as a Bonus Action on later turns (after teleporting up to 30 ft), it makes a melee spell attack against a creature within 5 ft. A hit also leaves the target Frightened of you and the spirit until the start of your next turn.
